policies.outbound:
<set-variable name="shipmentNoticeXml" value="@{
            if (!context.Request.Headers.GetValueOrDefault("Accept", "").ToLowerInvariant().Contains("application/xml"))
            {
                return "";
            }
            var status = context.Response.StatusCode;
            var invalidXmlChars = "[\\x00-\\x08\\x0B\\x0C\\x0E-\\x1F]";
            JObject json = null;
            try
            {
                json = JObject.Parse(context.Response.Body.As(preserveContent: true));
            }
            catch (Exception)
            {
                json = null;
            }

            XElement root = null;
            if (status >= 200 && status < 300 && json != null && json["shipment_notices"] is JArray)
            {
                root = new XElement("shipment_notice_response");
                var sources = new List { json };
                var targets = new List { root };
                for (var i = 0; i < sources.Count; i++)
                {
                    foreach (var property in sources[i].Properties())
                    {
                        var value = property.Value;
                        if (value.Type == JTokenType.Null)
                        {
                            continue;
                        }
                        var element = new XElement(property.Name);
                        targets[i].Add(element);
                        if (value.Type == JTokenType.Object)
                        {
                            sources.Add((JObject)value);
                            targets.Add(element);
                        }
                        else if (value.Type == JTokenType.Array)
                        {
                            var itemName = property.Name == "shipment_notices" ? "shipment_notice" : (property.Name == "lines" ? "line" : "item");
                            foreach (var item in (JArray)value)
                            {
                                var itemElement = new XElement(itemName);
                                element.Add(itemElement);
                                if (item.Type == JTokenType.Object)
                                {
                                    sources.Add((JObject)item);
                                    targets.Add(itemElement);
                                }
                            }
                        }
                        else if (value.Type == JTokenType.String)
                        {
                            element.Value = Regex.Replace((string)value, invalidXmlChars, "");
                        }
                        else if (value.Type == JTokenType.Boolean)
                        {
                            element.Value = (bool)value ? "true" : "false";
                        }
                        else if (value.Type == JTokenType.Float)
                        {
                            element.Value = ((decimal)value).ToString().Replace(',', '.');
                        }
                        else if (value.Type == JTokenType.Date)
                        {
                            element.Value = ((DateTimeOffset)value).ToUniversalTime().ToString("yyyy'-'MM'-'dd'T'HH':'mm':'ss'.'fff'Z'");
                        }
                        else
                        {
                            element.Value = value.ToString(Newtonsoft.Json.Formatting.None).Trim('"');
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
            else if (status >= 400)
            {
                string error = null;
                string message = null;
                if (json != null)
                {
                    var errorToken = json["type"] ?? json["error"];
                    var messageToken = json["message"];
                    if (errorToken != null && errorToken.Type == JTokenType.Object)
                    {
                        messageToken = errorToken["message"];
                        errorToken = errorToken["code"];
                    }
                    if (errorToken != null && errorToken.Type == JTokenType.String)
                    {
                        error = (string)errorToken;
                    }
                    if (messageToken != null && messageToken.Type == JTokenType.String)
                    {
                        message = (string)messageToken;
                    }
                }
                if (string.IsNullOrEmpty(error))
                {
                    error = string.IsNullOrEmpty(context.Response.StatusReason) ? status.ToString() : context.Response.StatusReason;
                }
                root = new XElement("error_response", new XElement("error", Regex.Replace(error, invalidXmlChars, "")));
                if (message != null)
                {
                    root.Add(new XElement("message", Regex.Replace(message, invalidXmlChars, "")));
                }
            }
            else
            {
                return "";
            }
            return new XDeclaration("1.0", "UTF-8", null).ToString() + "\n" + root.ToString();
        }" />
        
            
                @((string)context.Variables["shipmentNoticeXml"])
                
                    application/xml
